assessment.visualReadability: All seven corrected originals pass direct visual inspection. Largest-text dock title and full two-line sailing instruction are visible; selected voyage and capture strings fit; blocked launch reason is clear without a resource charge.
assessment.fontCapScope: The new cap is on messageOrVictims only when usesMaritimePieces is true. It does not cap the parent BoardDecisionDockView environment or alter dockHeight, action widths, below-board reserve, camera fit, legal target geometry, or non-maritime messages.
assessment.dynamicTypeTradeoff: At accessibility sizes the dense maritime command message is visually capped at DynamicTypeSize.large. This intentionally preserves complete instructions inside the fixed command row. Fleet and the in-game rulebook remain unrestricted native full-screen inspection paths. This is not a claim that the dock fully honors the largest visual text preference.
assessment.voiceOverAndFullText: The correction adds no accessibilityHidden or replacement/truncated accessibility label. The Text and Label retain complete presentation strings, and the native full-label lookup passes. Fleet rows preserve full name and sailing-status labels. Actual VoiceOver navigation/audio was not exercised by this reviewer.
assessment.OCRReliability: The new Vision assertion recognizes the rendered screenshot pixels within the observed detail rectangle, so an accessibility label containing undisplayed text cannot produce the prior false green. Accurate recognition with language correction disabled requires all three instruction phrases. Normalized point coordinates cancel the screenshot scale and invert y for the current portrait full-screen app frame.
assessment.boardSnapAndLayout: The readability correction does not touch board layout or input resolution. The existing blocked-hex polygon veto precedes nearest legal-target snapping. Corrected native evidence includes both local and World physical blocked-center touches, camera-value invariance, unchanged resources/positions/chart, capture confirmation with cold resumes, and the BoardViewportInvarianceTests and BelowBoardInvarianceTests selectors.

limitationsAndNonBlockingObservations: The OCR test currently asserts the detail phrases, not the title. The corrected title was verified manually in the original screenshot; adding an independent title pixel assertion would be an optional test improvement.

Vision recognition may produce false negatives after OS, typography or locale changes. Such failures should retain and inspect the original screenshot; they should not be waived solely because the accessibility label is complete.

ROI math assumes the current full-screen portrait app frame starts at zero. A future nonzero-origin or differently oriented test surface would need coordinate normalization relative to app.frame origin.
This receipt verifies the specified focused correction and native suite. It does not assert a fresh full quality gate, release archive, TestFlight availability, or device installation.
